summary: Anoka County, MN tower moved in 1957 from Wynne Lake near Biwabik to a site east of Anoka; removed in 2000; site now within a county park complex.

notes_for_editor: No build date found for the Wynne Lake tower, and no staffing or fire history found; the story leaves those out.
